Name: Howa's EWSF Farmer Portraits
Author: Howaa
Description:
Over the past few weeks, I've been creating portraits for my farmer, and I thought I'd share them here! 


[b][size=5]Installation & Requirements [/size][/b]
My farmer's name is Elothe, and so the portraits folder is named "Elothe". To install the portraits, you need to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226]Farmer Portraits ESWF[/url] and it's requirements ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]), navigate to the assets folder and drop my "Elothe" folder there. You will need to rename the folder to match your farmer's name to see the portraits in-game.

[b][size=4]Recommended Mods: [/size][/b]
I love using the mods [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337?tab=description]Portraited Changing Skies[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899]Portrait Frame Variations[/url][/b] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]. 
With the 2.1.1 - stable version of Portraited Changing Skies there is a gap at the farmer's head, unsure how to fix this! If anyone knows, please leave a comment! 
The blue borders in the screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23647]Shane UI[/url], which I am obsessed with! 


                                                                                                    ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mO9HFXO.png[/img]

[left]I've seen a few updated Farmer Portraits mod where the game can detect which outfit your farmer is wearing and switch your portrait ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34412]Farmer Portraits from FS Outfits[/url]﻿), so I'd like to make these portraits more modular and wayyyy more customizable, with different hair styles and colors --- maybe some animtion in the future?? I'm taking a break from working on the portraits as my "main" mod project to work on my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36630]castle farmhouse series[/url]﻿, I have an art blog [url=https://www.tumblr.com/howasstardewcorner]here[/url], so follow for updates on the portraits + the castle series! ﻿[/left][center]﻿[/center]     [img]https://i.imgur.com/8D1wRep.png[/img]
